sources.snippet: A: The base chinese-llama-2-7b is an untuned foundation model that generates raw text without instruction-following capability. The Alpaca-2 variant is instruction-tuned and ready for direct deployment in conversational and task-following scenarios without further fine-tuning.

sources.snippet: Model Overview This is the full version of the Chinese-Alpaca-2-7B model, which can be directly loaded for inference or full-parameter training. The model expands and optimizes the Chinese vocabulary based on Llama-2, uses large-scale Chinese data for incremental pre-training, and improves the basic semantic understanding of Chinese.
